collaborators: European Network of Gynaecological Oncological Trial Groups (ENGOT)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Determine optimal regimen of avutometinib (VS-6766) monotherapy or in combination with defactinib

Part D:To evaluate additional efficacy parameters for a lower dose of avutometinib in combination with defactinib

reasons: one of only 10 trials at this company

signals.text: No results posted 23 months after primary completion (Nov 2024)
signals.read: Past the 12-month FDAAA window. Delayed posting skews toward negative or unflattering results.
